conventions.convention: The scalar tensor uses signature (−,+,+,+), D_a ψ = ∂_a ψ − ieA_a ψ, and the explicitly displayed symmetric tensor with no mass or potential-energy term. Its physical interpretation requires separate adoption.

The fixed electric exterior uses A = −(Q/r)dt, A_t tending to zero at infinity, Φ_H = Q/r_+, length coordinates, and e with inverse-length units. Scattering conclusions concern only the subextremal branch and admitted modes.

Outward time-translation flux is minus the sphere integral of r² T^r_t. Incoming and reflected directional magnitudes are defined separately at infinity, using a real spherical harmonic with integral of Y² equal to one.
The polynomial constitutive coefficients are arbitrary fixed classical parameters. The small-invariant domain is an adopted regime label, without a QED matching or approximation-error assertion.

The residual comparison uses the max-component supremum norm on a nonempty compact chart cylinder, dimensionless ε, positive κ, inherited Countable Choice, and a separately assumed finite stability coefficient K(τ).

load_bearing.statement: For any admitted scattering mode with ω > 0 and A_in ≠ 0 under the specified tensor and asymptotic conventions, P_in = 2ω²|A_in|², P_ref = 2ω²|A_in|²|R|², and P_ref/P_in = |R|². No mode existence is asserted.

For supplied smooth Lorentzian geometry, smooth real A, real e, and smooth complex ψ, define D_a ψ = ∂_a ψ − ieA_a ψ and T_ab = conjugate(D_a ψ)D_b ψ + conjugate(D_b ψ)D_a ψ − g_ab g^{cd}conjugate(D_c ψ)D_d ψ.

Adopt a massless minimally coupled classical complex scalar equation and the specified scalar tensor on a prescribed electric RN-form open exterior with 0 < |Q| ≤ M; omit scalar sourcing and background response. No scattering existence or small-backreaction estimate is adopted.
